name: decks
description: Branded presentation system: agents write and refine a deck spec, one tested builder renders it, and QA checks the validator report and every rendered slide before a board-ready, NBG-branded PPTX ships. Also builds self-contained HTML decks the reader edits in the browser (text, free layout, pictures, slides) and exports to PDF. Bundles icon, infographic and device-mockup creative agents.
